inbox.generated: > Auto-generated by `node sync/scripts/sync.mjs inbox` — **do not edit by hand**. Workflow: [README.md](README.md).
inbox.pausedNote1: > Auto-generated by `node sync/scripts/sync.mjs inbox` — **do not edit by hand**. This side is paused, so it is
inbox.pausedNote2: > not listed in [INBOX.md](INBOX.md); this is the full list to review when it resumes (`paused` in `sync.config.json`).
inbox.col.title: Title
readme.col.label: Label
readme.flat: Flat layout: all notes live in `notes/` (module `general`).
readme.topology.single: single (one repo, sides tracked in sync notes)
cli.inboxStale: {file} is out of date — run `node sync/scripts/sync.mjs inbox` and commit it
cli.created: Created {path} — fill it in, then run `node sync/scripts/sync.mjs inbox`.
cli.contractWarn: {n} contract file(s) changed but no sync note was added or changed in this range:
notify.new: {from} raised a new sync note for {sides}
notify.newAsk: Please check it and update the status.
notify.disputedAsk: Please read the Discussion section and reply.
notify.closed: This sync note has been applied by every side
notify.missingEnv: {channel}: missing env {env} — printing the message instead of sending it
remind.title: {side}: sync notes waiting
remind.footer: When done, update the status in the note and run `node sync/scripts/sync.mjs inbox`.
remind.none: No sync notes waiting — no reminder sent.
doctor.engineManifest: engine files in sync/scripts match MANIFEST.json (reinstall with `sync.mjs install`; never edit or rewrite them)
doctor.kitVersion: kit versions match: scripts/VERSION {version}, config.kitVersion {config}, state.kitVersion {state}
doctor.readmeMarkers: sync/README.md has the generated and project-rules marker pairs
doctor.projectRules: project-rules block in sync/README.md is filled in (no TODO line left)
doctor.agentFilesDecided: state lists at least one agent file (`state decide --agent-file <path>`)
doctor.agentBlock: {file} contains the sync-kit marker block (`sync.mjs agent-rules --file {file}`)
doctor.ciDecided: CI choice recorded in state (`state decide --ci github|gitlab|none`)
doctor.gitlabWorkflowMrFail: no merge_request_event: MR pipelines may be disabled — sync-check would not run
doctor.hookExecutable: {file} is tracked by git as executable (100755)
doctor.hookMode: tracked as {mode}: run `git update-index --chmod=+x {file}` and commit
doctor.hookUntracked: not tracked: `git add {file}`, then `git update-index --chmod=+x {file}` and commit
doctor.hooksShadowed: core.hooksPath={dir} does not hide existing hooks in .git/hooks
doctor.hooksShadowedFail: hidden: {hooks} — move them into the hooks dir or chain them
doctor.hookActivated: pre-commit hook is active on this machine (core.hooksPath, husky, lefthook or pre-commit)
doctor.hookActivatedFail: each developer runs once: git config core.hooksPath {dir}
doctor.telegramManagers: every active side has managers in notify.managers (telegram mentions)
doctor.gitlabScheduleManual: Pipeline schedule (variable SYNC_REMIND=1) must be created by hand in the GitLab UI — doctor cannot check it
doctor.notesExist: at least one sync note exists ({n})
doctor.placeholderReplaced: {file}: `{placeholder}` is replaced with the default branch
doctor.reminderCron: {file}: the line right after `# SYNC_KIT_CRON` is a `- cron:` entry
